claims.claim_ar: تكرار أداة التوكيد «إِنّ» (فَإِنْ ... فَإِنَّ) في مطلع الآية لزيادة التأكيد والشدّة.
claims.claim_en: Repetition of the emphatic particle 'inna' (إِنّ) — as in فَإِنْ ... فَإِنَّ — at the opening of the verse, producing increased emphasis and intensity.
claims.rhetorical_effect: intensifies the warning/assertion; sharpens attention to God's knowledge of the corrupters
